what_it_does: Some modern AI and analytics workloads — like recommendation systems that predict what users want to see, or social-network analysis that finds communities — need more memory than fits on a graphics processing unit (GPU). When data overflows GPU memory, the current approach forces programs to pause and wait for slow data transfers from disk to happen, wasting time and electricity. AGILE solves this by letting computations and data transfers happen at the same time, so the GPU never sits idle waiting for data. It includes a smart memory cache that lives on the fastest on-chip storage (called HBM, high-bandwidth memory) and uses lock-free data structures that allow multiple threads to work together without slowing each other down.
